name: Bug Catcher
description: The first Bug monster you buy each round is free.

name: Chef
description: Your singled-typed monsters gain Fire typing. Your Fire monsters have +2 Burn.

name: Chemist
description: Your Toxic monsters have +1 Poison. When any monster levels up, increase this effect by +1 Poison.

name: Egg Breeder
description: Gain a Purple Egg that hatches into a level 2 Super Rare monster in 5 days.

name: Gamer
description: Gain a Mythical monster and $30 on day 9.

name: Lucky Girl
description: SHINY monsters are more likely to appear.

name: Mad Scientist
description: On day 7, transform monsters on your active team into random level 1 Legendary monsters.

name: Masked Man
description: Every 4 days, choose a trainer and gain their ability.

name: Monster Ranger
description: Start with an Uncommon monster. Get another copy of that monster every 2 days.

name: Musician
description: If you have exactly 1 Electric monster on your team, it will have +150% Shock.

name: Redhead
description:
On Victory
Give your Fire monsters +2 Burn permanently.

name: Shopkeeper
description: Your shop stocks Item 1 rarity tier higher and cost 15% less.

name: Swim Coach
description: Gain a random Water monster each day.

name: Treasure Hunter
description: When you get Trinket gifts, your choices are 1 rarity tier higher.
